fact: The 2026/27 budget confirms that 52 public services are fully available online on the 1Gov1Citizen integrated e-services platform, with 179 more in final integration testing, per BWTechZone reporting the budget speech.
The budget confirms continued investment in the 1Gov1Citizen integrated e-services platform, with 52 public services fully online and 179 more under final integration testing.

ADM Interactive says 1Gov is Botswana's central online portal giving citizens access to government services, assessed in 2023 as unstable, poorly integrated with agencies and with little public uptake.
